clockSkewSeconds.description: Agent clock minus the last server time seen; provisional field.

firewallProfiles.description: Each firewall profile on or off, as last seen by the agent's firewall watcher; compared with the client's firewall policy. Absent until the watcher has looked once (and from agents before milestone 9).

timeZoneId.description: The cabinet's Windows time zone, compared with its site's time zone. Absent from agents before the time operations.
